analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 49.0 remains in neutral territory, while MACD histogram is improving to -179.9101 but still showing weak convergence. Despite five consecutive daily closes in the green, the price is consolidating near the SMA20 resistance at 33,513 KRW and the swing support at 32,655 KRW, searching for direction. ADX at 28.7 indicates a clear trend, but the -DI (33.0) is stronger than +DI (24.7), suggesting downward pressure. Lacking clear buy/sell signals, a wait-and-see approach is warranted.
